resources.string: Glasses Assistant is a hands-free, eyes-free voice interface. When you speak a command through your Bluetooth glasses or headset, this service reads what is currently on your screen and performs a single action you asked for — such as opening an app or tapping a button — then speaks the result back to you. It acts only when you trigger a voice turn. It is intended for hands-free and accessibility use while your phone stays in your pocket.
Keeps the voice assistant listening in the background.
Tap Talk to speak a command.
